description: A Drupal form class for managing migration message filters, including building the filter form, handling submission, and resetting filters.

classes.name: MessageForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for filtering migration messages, providing UI for message and severity filters, and handling form submission and reset.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the form and sets string translation service.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the filter form with message and severity filters, and action buttons.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating session filters based on user input.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the filter session data, clearing applied filters.
